subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

AIDS will have been cured by the year 2070 by scientists.

options.text: Scientists will have cured AIDS by the year 2070.
Scientists cured AIDS by the year 2070.
Scientists will cure AIDS by the year 2070.
Scientists must have cured AIDS by the year 2070.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Scientists will have cured AIDS by the year 2070."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given question is in passive voice and we need to change this to active voice.
 
• The subject of the phrase performs the action on the action's target in the active voice.
 
• The action's target is the primary consideration in the passive voice, and the verb affects the subject.
 
• The **structure of active voice** of **future perfect tense**: **Subject + will have/will has + main verb(past participle form) + object.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

Therefore,** **the correct active voice is** "Scientists will have cured AIDS by the year 2070."**
